title: The team, one agent at a time: a Work-queue ticket for each of the 30 roles and the 12 advocates, and the session manager's seven tickets of Nov 28
why: Jason, 2026-11-28, through the CEO and the session manager: "Bring each one online individually… just in case we run out of usage". Goal: the transition cutover by Dec 15 (the team scales claims toward the ladder). The queue is the only development lane, so each agent's release needs its ticket first.

log.msg: Waiting for its before look: the advocates look at staging as it is, then it goes on staging (the before-and-after check).
Plan approved (no switch: everyone at once when published), advancing on schedule.
